record.title: Read current SCPI identity and ordinary entitlement statuses
record.intent: Present fresh literal identity and option-status responses to the operator.
requirements: Under fresh full capture and existing host isolation send one IDN query and the eleven documented ordinary option-status queries only.
Preserve raw request and response bytes, verify capture closure and host restoration, and keep unit identifiers in private evidence rather than source.
Distinguish the reported model and serial from an unestablished separate machine identifier; make no configuration changes or RF claims.
acceptance: Fresh responses are preserved and shown to the operator.
